title: ‘Exorcism of God’ Director Alejandro Hidalgo to Helm Malaysian Hungry Ghost Festival Horror ‘The Hungry One’ (EXCLUSIVE)
content:
ByNaman Ramachandran

Alejandro Hidalgo, director of “The Exorcism of God,” is set to make “The Hungry One,” a supernatural horror film unfolding over Malaysia’s Hungry Ghost Festival.

Kuala Lumpur-based Abnormal Studios is handling worldwide sales and is introducing the project at theBusan International Film Festival‘s Asian Contents & Film Market. Singapore-based Clover Films has already picked up rights for Singapore, Malaysia and Indonesia.

The story follows Emily, an American woman who travels with Simon, her Chinese Malaysian husband, and their son Louis to spend the summer at his family’s mansion. Their stay coincides with the 15-day festival, when the underworld is believed to open and the dead mingle with the living. Emily becomes the target of escalating encounters with a vengeful presence trying to cross over, and must dig into the house’s hidden past before it takes her family.

Filmmaker and entrepreneur Justin Leong is driving the project through Los Angeles-based Lightning Pictures.

“Growing up in Asia, I always felt the Hungry Ghost Festival was incredibly rich visually, from the fire and offerings to the rituals and mythology behind it. When you capture that and shoot it cinematically, it’s movie gold. It gives us a world that audiences may not have seen before, but one that feels immediately atmospheric, mysterious and made for horror,” Leong said.

Leong, who has deep ties to Malaysian-Chinese culture, drew on his own family’s traditions to shape the story.

Hidalgo’s first feature, “The House at the End of Time,” remains Venezuela’s biggest horror hit at the box office. It earned strong notices on the festival circuit and has since gathered a cult audience for mixing the supernatural with science fiction. His 2021 follow-up, “The Exorcism of God,” bowed at Fantastic Fest and went on to sell to more than 150 countries, with Saban Films handling its U.S. theatrical release. It ended 2022 as the highest-grossing Latin American film worldwide.

Producer Harrison Allen, who won the live action short Oscar at this year’s Academy Awards for Netflix title “The Singers,” is also on board. His latest feature, “Anima,” screened at SXSW this year.

Also attached is Thomas Percy Kim, a Sundance and Toronto fellow whose debut feature “Isle Child,” based on his own short that HBO Max acquired, premiered in Toronto. Screenwriter Justin Parker worked on the development of HBO’s Emmy-nominated limited series “Station Eleven” and was a writer on docuseries “Religion of Sports.”

“The Hungry One” is in pre-production, with its producers working to lock the last portion of its financing.

Abnormal Studios, a subsidiary of Westec Media Limited, has been acquiring and releasing films since 2020 and has handled more than 400 titles to date. It now brings around 100 films a year to Southeast Asia, Australia, New Zealand, Taiwan, Mongolia and Nepal. Recent releases include “How to Make Millions Before Grandma Dies” and “Twilight of the Warriors: Walled In.”
title_zh: 《上帝的驅魔》(Exorcism of God) 導演亞歷杭德羅·希達哥(Alejandro Hidalgo) 將執導馬來西亞的餓鬼節恐怖片《餓鬼》(The Hungry One)（獨家報導）。
content_zh:
作者：納曼·拉馬昌德蘭(Naman Ramachandran)

導演亞歷杭德羅·希達哥(Alejandro Hidalgo)將製作超自然恐怖片《饑餓者》(The Hungry One)，故事背景設置在馬來西亞的餓鬼節。

位於吉隆坡的異常工作室(Abnormal Studios)負責全球銷售，並在釜山國際電影節的亞洲內容與電影市場上介紹該項目。位於新加坡的克勞佛影業(Clover Films)已經獲得新加坡、馬來西亞和印尼的發行權。

故事講述美國女性艾蜜莉(Emily)與她的中國馬來西亞丈夫西蒙(Simon)及他們的兒子路易(Louis)一起前往他的家族豪宅度過夏天。他們的逗留恰逢為期15天的節日，據信陰間會開啟，亡者與生者交融。艾蜜莉成為一個試圖跨越的復仇存在的目標，必須挖掘這座房子的隱藏過去，才能拯救她的家人。

電影製作人兼企業家賈斯汀·梁(Justin Leong)正在洛杉磯的閃電影業(Lightning Pictures)推動這個項目。

“在亞洲長大，我一直覺得餓鬼節在視覺上非常豐富，從火焰和供品到背後的儀式和神話。當你捕捉到這些並以電影的方式拍攝時，那就是電影的黃金。它為我們提供了一個觀眾可能未曾見過的世界，但卻立即感受到氛圍、神秘，並適合恐怖片的需求，”梁說。

梁與馬來西亞華人文化有著深厚的聯繫，並借鑒了自己家庭的傳統來塑造這個故事。

希達哥的首部長片《時間的盡頭的房子》(The House at the End of Time)仍然是委內瑞拉票房最高的恐怖片。該片在影展上獲得了良好的評價，並因其將超自然與科幻混合而聚集了一批狂熱觀眾。他在2021年的後續作品《上帝的驅魔》(The Exorcism of God)在Fantastic Fest首映，並在150多個國家發行，由薩班影業(Saban Films)負責其美國院線發行。該片在2022年結束時成為全球票房最高的拉丁美洲電影。

製片人哈里森·艾倫(Harrison Allen)也參與了該項目，他因Netflix的短片《歌者》(The Singers)在今年的奧斯卡頒獎典禮上獲得真人短片奧斯卡。他的最新長片《靈魂》(Anima)在今年的SXSW放映。

還有托馬斯·珀西·金(Thomas Percy Kim)參與該項目，他是一位參加過聖丹斯和多倫多影展的獎學金得主，他的首部長片《島嶼孩子》(Isle Child)基於他自己的短片，已被HBO Max收購並在多倫多首映。編劇賈斯汀·帕克(Justin Parker)曾參與HBO艾美獎提名的限量劇《第十一站》(Station Eleven)的開發，並是紀錄片系列《運動的宗教》(Religion of Sports)的編劇。

《饑餓者》(The Hungry One)目前處於前期製作階段，製片人正在努力鎖定最後一部分的資金。

異常影業(Abnormal Studios)，是西泰克媒體有限公司(Westec Media Limited)的子公司，自2020年以來一直在收購和發行電影，至今已處理超過400部作品。該公司每年為東南亞、澳大利亞、新西蘭、台灣、蒙古和尼泊爾帶來約100部電影。最近的發行包括《如何在奶奶去世前賺取百萬》(How to Make Millions Before Grandma Dies)和《戰士的黃昏：圍牆內》(Twilight of the Warriors: Walled In)。
